title: fork() for Agents: Agent Kernel for Non-blocking LLM Orchestration
abstract: arXiv:2611.31727v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based agents typically execute tool calls synchronously and discard completed work upon failure. Subgraph-selective recovery, re-executing only a failed node's transitive descendants, is a well-established pattern in distributed systems (Spark, Erlang/OTP, Dryad), and recent agent runtimes (Sherlock, AgentGit, Atomix) preserve completed work through verifiers, version control, or transactional tool boundaries. We present \textbf{Agent-Kernel}, a non-blocking runtime that ports this pattern to the LLM \emph{content plane}: its primitive, \textbf{Sub-Graph Recovery (SGR)}, fires on a raw exception with no trained verifier or planner, resets a failed node's descendants while preserving completed siblings, and composes each parent's text into its children's prompts (context inheritance), all on a durable substrate with a formal state-preservation guarantee. translated_title: 面向智能体的fork()：用于非阻塞LLM编排的Agent内核
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的智能体通常同步执行工具调用，并在失败时丢弃已完成的工作。子图选择性恢复——即仅重新执行失败节点的传递性后代——是分布式系统中一种成熟的模式（如Spark、Erlang/OTP、Dryad），而近期的智能体运行时（Sherlock、AgentGit、Atomix）则通过验证器、版本控制或事务性工具边界来保留已完成的工作。我们提出了**Agent-Kernel**，一个非阻塞运行时，将这一模式移植到LLM的*内容平面*：其核心原语——**子图恢复**——可在原始异常发生时触发，无需经过训练的验证器或规划器，在重置失败节点后代的同时保留已完成的兄弟节点，并将每个父节点的文本组合进其子节点的提示中（上下文继承），所有这些都构建在具有形式化状态保持保证的持久化基底之上。在合成基准和标准基准（tau-bench、Gaia2、Auto……）上共计14,434次运行中……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Agent-Kernel是一个非阻塞LLM智能体运行时，其核心原语“子图恢复”（SGR）能够在原始异常发生时无需训练过的验证器或规划器，仅重置失败节点的后代、保留已完成的兄弟节点工作并实现父子上下文继承，从而将分布式系统中成熟的子图选择性恢复模式移植到LLM编排的内容平面。
en_tdlr: Agent-Kernel is a non-blocking runtime for LLM agents whose Sub-Graph Recovery (SGR) primitive, triggered by raw exceptions without any trained verifier or planner, resets only a failed node's descendants while preserving completed sibling work and enabling parent-to-child context inheritance—porting the well-established subgraph-selective recovery pattern from distributed systems to the LLM content plane.
